cards.note:
# Make rows.mjs honest: contract → page consumer

## Background
The records case row script is supposed to trace mechanically C# Rivet contract → controller → the frontend page that consumes it (here `apps/ui/app/pages/records/`): "of your contract, these routes are consumed in your page; those are the routes your unit needs to test." The page leg does not exist.

## What the script actually does
- Reads exactly four sources: `packages/contracts/generated/openapi.json` plus hard-coded `RecordsContract.cs`, `RecordsController.cs`, `RecordTypesContract.cs`, `RecordTypesController.cs` (rows.mjs:39-44, 78-87); never opens a file under `pages/records/`.
- Scope is two string constants: `ROUTE_PREFIX = "/api/records"` (rows.mjs:40), `LIST_ROUTE = "/api/record-types"` (rows.mjs:44); the case folder's location is irrelevant to which routes become rows.
- Keep the parts that work: the spec↔C# route-constant staleness check and the controller `[Http...]` location for `Where`.

## Concrete misses in the current case
- `GET /api/cases` is consumed at `composables/useRecordDetail.ts:33` — no row (matches neither constant).
- `POST /api/record-types/{id}/archive` (`ArchiveRoute`) — cited by the case's own `records_issue_404` CantHappen chain, but only the exact `GET /api/record-types` is admitted.
- The record-types list is consumed through an out-of-dir import (`useRecordIssuance.ts:4` → `~/features/record-types/queries`), so the trace must follow the page tree's import graph to the `api.METHOD("/api/...")` call sites.

## Acceptance
- Scope is derived from the page: rows = the spec's routes ∩ the routes the page tree consumes (following imports). A new contract route consumed from the records page produces a row with no edit to rows.mjs.
- Keeps the spec↔contract check and controller `Where`; also reports the page call site (file:line) per route.
- Re-freeze the case: `rows` re-run, table diff reviewed by the user, fill pass re-run for the new rows.

comments.content:
**rows2.mjs built alongside rows.mjs** (uncommitted, swap pending):

- `apps/ui/app/pages/records/__oracle__/rows2.mjs` — proper row script: ts-morph binding-level trace of the page tree (imports, auto-import composables with destructuring restriction, template component edges by import vs auto-registration), C# contract discovery by route-constant **value** (staleness check kept, stronger), controller `[Http<Verb>]` scan for `Where`. Rows = spec ∩ consumed ∩ scope. New `ConsumedAt` field per row.
- Routes are arguments, not hardcoded: `--page <dir>` + repeatable `--route '[METHOD] path[/*]'` (e.g. `--route '/api/records/*' --route 'GET /api/record-types' --route /api/cases`).
- Proto noise fixed: call-site dedupe key (file:line:method:route), template-edge label distinguishes imported vs auto-registered, conservative walks printed once each.
- Verified run for records: **63 rows, 0 unplaced** (records 59, record-types 2, cases 2). All 61 rows shared with the current rows.mjs are field-identical (same Wheres from the C# value match); v2 adds only the cases rows (scoped by arg) + ConsumedAt.
- Discovery finding: `CreateRoute` and `ListRoute` in `RecordTypesContract.cs` **both equal "/api/record-types"** — verb disambiguates (row narrowing: value → verb → endpoint name). The script handles it; worth knowing when reading the contract.
- Tests: `apps/ui/tests/oracle/rows2.spec.ts` + fixture mini-app under `tests/fixtures/oracle-rows2/` — 13 vitest tests pin the tracer/scan/rows as infrastructure, including the k36 acceptance case: a newly consumed route yields a row with no script edit. All green; oxlint/eslint/oxfmt clean.
- `ts-morph ^28` added to `apps/ui` devDependencies (pnpm-lock updated).
- Swap flow when ready: rows2's content replaces `rows.mjs` (case `.gitignore` whitelists only `rows.mjs`), `oracle.conf.json` rows command gains `--page/--route`, re-freeze, table diff review, fill pass re-run. Cases slice folder will appear (`cases/oracle.jsonl`).
